setting_ko: 오전 9시, 동네 카페 '메이플 스트리트 커피' 계산대 앞에 섰습니다. 음료를 주문하고 옵션을 바꾼 뒤 가격을 확인해 보세요.

facts.sizes: Small (12 oz) or large (16 oz); every drink can be hot or iced
facts.milk_options: Whole milk is the default; oat milk or almond milk costs $0.70 extra
facts.extras: Extra espresso shot $1.00; vanilla or caramel syrup $0.60; decaf at no extra charge
facts.sold_out: The chocolate croissant is sold out today
facts.pickup: For-here drinks come in a mug; to-go drinks in a paper cup; drinks are picked up at the end of the counter

opening_line.en: Hi there, welcome to Maple Street Coffee! What can I get started for you today?
opening_line.ko: 안녕하세요, 메이플 스트리트 커피에 오신 걸 환영해요! 오늘 뭘로 준비해 드릴까요?

goals.en: Order a drink and say the size
Change an option such as the milk, syrup, or an extra shot
Ask about or confirm the total price

allowed_flow: Greet the customer and take their drink order.
Ask about size, hot or iced, milk, and for here or to go only when the customer has not said it.
Offer menu items and options only from the facts; if something is not on the menu, say so and suggest a similar item.
If the customer asks for a chocolate croissant, say it is sold out today and suggest the blueberry muffin or the bagel.
Repeat the order back and state the total using only prices from the facts.
Take payment and tell the customer where to pick up the drink.
Stay in the cafe setting; if the customer changes the topic, answer briefly and return to the order.

easy.guidance_en: Use short, simple sentences and everyday words. Offer two choices at a time, for example 'Small or large?'. Say prices plainly in dollars and cents.

normal.guidance_en: Use natural, friendly cafe language. Ask one follow-up question at a time and confirm details briefly.

hard.guidance_en: Talk like a busy barista with casual phrasing and contractions. Suggest one add-on or mention a sold-out item so the customer has to adjust the order.

hints.example_en: I'd like a large latte, please.

hints.ko: 매장에서 마실지, 가져갈지도 말할 수 있어요.
hints.example_en: Can I get a small drip coffee to go?

hints.ko: 우유 종류나 시럽을 바꿔 달라고 요청해 보세요.
hints.example_en: Could I have almond milk instead of whole milk?

hints.ko: 샷 추가나 디카페인을 요청할 수도 있어요.
hints.example_en: Could you add an extra shot?

hints.ko: 총 금액을 묻거나, 들은 금액이 맞는지 다시 확인해 보세요.

model_expressions.en: Could I get a large iced tea, please?
model_expressions.ko: 라지 사이즈 아이스티 한 잔 주시겠어요?

model_expressions.en: I'd like a small latte for here, please.
model_expressions.ko: 스몰 라테 한 잔 주세요. 매장에서 마실게요.

model_expressions.en: Can I get that with oat milk instead?
model_expressions.ko: 그거 오트 밀크로 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

model_expressions.en: Could you add an extra shot of espresso?
Actually, could you make that decaf?
model_expressions.ko: 아, 그거 디카페인으로 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

model_expressions.en: Just to check, is that $5.65 for the large latte with oat milk?
model_expressions.ko: 확인차 여쭤볼게요, 라지 라테에 오트 밀크까지 해서 5.65달러 맞나요?

reading.en: I'd like a large cappuccino with oat milk, please.
Could you make it a little less sweet?
reading.ko: 조금 덜 달게 해 주실 수 있나요?

reading.en: I'll have a blueberry muffin, too.

shadowing.en: Could I get that to go, please?
Actually, can I change that to a small?
shadowing.ko: 아, 그거 스몰로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

shadowing.en: Thanks so much, have a great day!

free_answer.question_en: What do you usually order at a coffee shop, and why?
free_answer.question_ko: 카페에서 보통 무엇을 주문하나요? 이유도 말해 보세요.
free_answer.sample_answer_en: I usually order an iced americano because it's refreshing and not too sweet. When I'm tired in the afternoon, I sometimes add an extra shot.

free_answer.question_en: Your drink came with the wrong milk. What would you say to the barista?
free_answer.question_ko: 음료에 주문과 다른 우유가 들어갔어요. 바리스타에게 뭐라고 말할까요?
free_answer.sample_answer_en: Excuse me, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for oat milk, but this tastes like regular milk. Could you remake it for me, please?
